source_findings: Pinned EIA footnote s_379ceb3c45f341ef establishes at least one MW total generating capacity for utility-scale. Footnote s_d7571401d3a80385 establishes less than one MW for small solar PV and excludes connection to a power plant with combined capacity of one MW or more.
Both raw and stored claims preserve exact inequalities, capacity measure and the combined-plant distinction. Accepted by NeMo, with no fallback or editorial change.
